```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(forecast)

stack_overfl_qs <- read.csv('StackOverflowData.csv')
head(stack_overfl_qs)

stack_overfl_qs$month <- as.Date(paste0("01-", stack_overfl_qs$month), format="%d-%y-%b")
print(head(stack_overfl_qs))

timeseries <- stack_overfl_qs[, c('month', 'python')]
timeseries <- na.omit(timeseries)

python_ts <- ts(timeseries$python, frequency=12)
head(timeseries)


if(length(python_ts) >= 2*12) {
  decomp1 <- decompose(python_ts, type = "multiplicative")
  decomp2 <- decompose(python_ts, type = "additive")
} else {
  message("Not enough periods for decompose(), using STL instead")
  decomp1 <- stl(ts(timeseries$python, frequency=10), s.window="periodic")
  decomp2 <- stl(ts(timeseries$python, frequency=5), s.window="periodic")
}


par(mfrow=c(4,1), mar=c(3,4,2,2))

if(exists("decomp1") && "x" %in% names(decomp1)) {
  plot(decomp1$x, main="Decomposition of Python Qs asked over time", ylab="Observed")
  plot(decomp1$trend, main="", ylab="Trend")
  plot(decomp1$seasonal, main="", ylab="Seasonal")
  plot(decomp1$random, main="", ylab="Residual")
} else {
  plot(python_ts, main="Decomposition of Python Qs asked over time", ylab="Observed")
  plot(decomp1$time.series[,"trend"], main="", ylab="Trend")
  plot(decomp1$time.series[,"seasonal"], main="", ylab="Seasonal")
  plot(decomp1$time.series[,"remainder"], main="", ylab="Residual")
}



```
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(forecast)
library(tseries)
library(lubridate)
library(Metrics)  

stack_overfl_qs <- read.csv('StackOverflowData.csv')
stack_overfl_qs$month <- as.Date(paste0("01-", stack_overfl_qs$month), format="%d-%y-%b")
timeseries <- stack_overfl_qs[, c('month', 'python')]
timeseries <- na.omit(timeseries)
rownames(timeseries) <- as.character(timeseries$month)

for (i in 1:10) {
  lag_col_name <- paste("Lag", i)
  timeseries[[lag_col_name]] <- lag(timeseries$python, i)
}

strikeout <- na.omit(timeseries)
head(strikeout)

series <- timeseries$python
par(mfrow=c(1,1))
acf(series, main="python Qs saked ACF Plot")

pacf(series, main="Python values PACF Plot")

train_size <- floor(0.8 * nrow(timeseries))
train_data <- timeseries[1:train_size, ]
test_data <- timeseries[(train_size+1):nrow(timeseries), ]

y_train <- train_data$python
y_test <- test_data$python

plot(timeseries$month, timeseries$python, type="l", 
     xlab="Year", ylab="Python Rate", 
     main="Python Qs over Training Data")
legend("topleft", legend=c("(Training) Python Rate"), lty=1)



```
```{r}
library(forecast)
library(tseries)
library(lubridate)


y_train_ts <- ts(train_data$python)


ar_model <- Arima(y_train_ts, order=c(1,0,0))

summary(ar_model)

ar_pred <- forecast(ar_model, h=length(test_data$python))

pred_data2 <- data.frame(
  Year = test_data$month,
  pred_Python_Qs = as.numeric(ar_pred$mean)
)

rownames(pred_data2) <- as.character(pred_data2$Year)

head(pred_data2)

plot(test_data$month, test_data$python, type="l", ylim=range(c(test_data$python, pred_data2$pred_Python_Qs)),
     xlab="Year", ylab="Python Qs", main="AR Model Predictions", col="blue")
lines(test_data$month, pred_data2$pred_Python_Qs, col="orange", lty=2)
legend("topleft", legend=c("Actual Python Qs", "AR Predicted Python Qs"), 
       col=c("blue", "orange"), lty=c(1,2))



```
```{r}
library(forecast)
library(Metrics)


full_pred <- predict(ar_model, n.ahead = length(y_test))


ar_pred <- c(fitted(ar_model), full_pred$pred)


ar_pred <- ar_pred[!is.na(ar_pred)]


mae_val <- mae(y_test, ar_pred)
rmse_val <- rmse(y_test, ar_pred)

cat(sprintf("Mean Absolute Error: %.2f\n", mae_val))
cat(sprintf("Root Mean Squared Error: %.2f\n", rmse_val))


```
```{r}
library(forecast)
library(Metrics)

arma_model <- Arima(y_train, order=c(5,1,10))


summary(arma_model)

arma_forecast <- forecast(arma_model, h=length(y_test))
arma_pred <- arma_forecast$mean

pred_data <- data.frame(
  Year = test_data$month,
  python = as.numeric(arma_pred)
)

rownames(pred_data) <- as.character(pred_data$Year)

head(pred_data)

plot(test_data$month, test_data$python, type="l", 
     xlab="Year", ylab="Python Qs", main="ARIMA Model Predictions",
     col="blue")
lines(pred_data$Year, pred_data$python, col="orange", lty=2)
legend("topleft", legend=c("Python CloQsse", "ARIMA Predicted Python Qs"), 
       col=c("blue", "orange"), lty=c(1,2))

mae_val <- mae(y_test, arma_pred)
rmse_val <- rmse(y_test, arma_pred)

cat(sprintf("Mean Absolute Error: %.2f\n", mae_val))
cat(sprintf("Root Mean Squared Error: %.2f\n", rmse_val))

mae_alt <- mean(abs(y_test[1] - arma_pred[1]))
rmse_alt <- sqrt(mean((y_test[1] - arma_pred[1])^2))

cat(sprintf("Mean Absolute Error (base R): %.2f\n", mae_alt))
cat(sprintf("Root Mean Squared Error (base R): %.2f\n", rmse_alt))

mae_all <- mae(y_test, arma_pred)
rmse_all <- rmse(y_test, arma_pred)
cat(sprintf("\nMetrics for full test period:\n"))
cat(sprintf("Mean Absolute Error (all): %.2f\n", mae_all))
cat(sprintf("Root Mean Squared Error (all): %.2f\n", rmse_all))
```
